targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(total_wait_ms) AS selected_wait_ms FROM qv_report.wait_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${archived_period} AND wait_category IN (${wait_category:csv})

WITH b AS (SELECT SUM(total_wait_ms) total_wait_ms FROM qv_report.wait_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${baseline_period} AND wait_category IN (${wait_category:csv})), c AS (SELECT SUM(total_wait_ms) total_wait_ms FROM qv_report.wait_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${archived_period} AND wait_category IN (${wait_category:csv})) SELECT 100.0 * (c.total_wait_ms - b.total_wait_ms) / NULLIF(b.total_wait_ms, 0) AS change_pct FROM b CROSS JOIN c

SELECT wait_category_desc AS metric, total_wait_ms AS value FROM qv_report.wait_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${archived_period} AND wait_category IN (${wait_category:csv}) ORDER BY total_wait_ms DESC

WITH b AS (SELECT wait_category, wait_category_desc, total_wait_ms FROM qv_report.wait_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${baseline_period}), c AS (SELECT wait_category, wait_category_desc, total_wait_ms FROM qv_report.wait_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${archived_period}) SELECT COALESCE(c.wait_category_desc, b.wait_category_desc) wait_category, COALESCE(b.total_wait_ms, 0) baseline_wait_ms, COALESCE(c.total_wait_ms, 0) selected_wait_ms, COALESCE(c.total_wait_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_wait_ms, 0) delta_ms, 100.0 * (COALESCE(c.total_wait_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_wait_ms, 0)) / NULLIF(b.total_wait_ms, 0) delta_pct FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN c ON c.wait_category = b.wait_category WHERE COALESCE(c.wait_category, b.wait_category) IN (${wait_category:csv}) ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(c.total_wait_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_wait_ms, 0)) DESC

SELECT TOP (50) query_id, query_hash_hex, query_text_preview, SUM(total_wait_ms) AS total_wait_ms, MAX(max_query_wait_time_ms) AS max_query_wait_time_ms FROM qv_report.query_wait_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${archived_period} AND wait_category IN (${wait_category:csv}) GROUP BY query_id, query_hash_hex, query_text_preview ORDER BY total_wait_ms DESC
